forgot.subtitle: Reset your password
forgot.hint: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

rules.passwordStrength: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.

errors.emailInUse: The email address is already in use by another account.
errors.invalidEmail: The email address is badly formatted.
errors.wrongPassword: The password is invalid or the user does not have a password.
errors.invalidCredential: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.userNotFound: There is no user record corresponding to this identifier. The user may have been deleted.
errors.userDisabled: The user account has been disabled by an administrator.
errors.weakPassword: The password must be 6 characters long or more.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.accountExists: An account already exists with the same email address but different sign-in credentials. Sign in using a provider associated with this email address.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.resetLinkExpired: This reset link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link isn't valid or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
